export_evidence: ImportKey page for HMT MACHINE TOOLS LIMITED (59, Bellary Road, Bangalore) shows 'Total Shipments 76 Records detected' but every visible row is an INBOUND shipment where HMT is the buyer, e.g. '2026-02-12 WTO WERKZEUG-EINRICHTUNGEN GMBH -> HMT Machine Tools Limited ... FRANKFURTMAIN INTL, GERMANY -> COCHIN AIR CARGO ACC INCOK4, India, HS 84661010, BOL 7475512'. No outbound/export row with an Indian port of loading and foreign destination was seen. Source counter: page claims 76 shipments; rows actually displayed = 5 (all imports).
domestic_evidence: Company site lists 'Contracts Awarded' and 'Tenders' sections, but the Contracts Awarded page only carries HMT Limited group-level monthly contract PDFs for 2018-2019 (last updated 8 Dec 2022) and no HMT Machine Tools Ltd-specific contract line or value was readable; the Financial Information page returned no figures ('Last Updated on January 21, 2021' with empty body). No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP award or annual-report revenue split could be retrieved.
note: HMT Machine Tools Limited is a public-sector (HMT Limited group) machine-tool maker, Bangalore, six units (Bangalore, Pinjore, Kalamassery, Hyderabad, Ajmer, Praga). Declared HS 846012 (flat-surface grinding machines) is plausible for its product range but no shipment record ties this company to that code; the only HS codes actually observed are import codes 84661010, 84122990, 84669390, 68042190, 84821090. Export activity of the HMT group is channelled through the separate subsidiary HMT (International) Limited ('Exports & Imports, Turnkey Projects & Consultancy'), so HMT Machine Tools Ltd itself shows no export bill-of-lading in the free sources checked. Revenue and export volume: null - not public in the pages retrieved. Volza, Eximpedia and Trademo returned HTTP 403 and DuckDuckGo search was unavailable, so coverage is limited to ImportKey plus the company website; absence of export records is therefore 'none_found in sources checked', not proof of no exports. No traces of confirmed supplies found in the sources checked.
